grok.pulse: NQ closed +6.5% in the biggest session since Apr 2025 as Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, sending NVDA +31% and unleashing a massive AI relief rally after last week's rout, while oil slid on Middle East supply and Dec FOMC hike odds stayed near 98%.
grok.bias: risk-on — Huang's return and short-covering snapped the AI trade back with VIX collapsing ~25% and NQ/ES ripping, but near-certain December hike pricing, hawkish Williams comments and lingering Iran/Hormuz risks keep follow-through fragile into the holiday week
